## Submission details

- Exact model ID/version:
- Answer file (`submissions/<model>-<date>.json`):
- Generation date, temperature, max_tokens and reasoning settings:
- Prior exposure to questions, rubrics or reference answers (describe, or state none):
- Local validation result:
- Test-only submission? Yes / No

Do not include API keys or private judge records. Format validation does not imply scoring or leaderboard approval. Test-only PRs must use **TEST ONLY — DO NOT MERGE** in the title.
